title: The structure of $\lim^1$-groups
summary: If $(A_n)_n$ is a decreasing filtration of a module $A$ and $\widehat{A} = \lim_n A/A_n$, then $\lim^1_n A_n$ is identified with the cokernel of the canonical map $A \longrightarrow \widehat{A}$. In this note, we show that any $\lim^1$-group is canonically of that form: For any inverse sequence of modules $(X_n)_n$ there exists an inverse sequence $(A_n)_n$ as above and a morphism $(A_n)_n \longrightarrow (X_n)_n$, depending functorially on $(X_n)_n$, that induces an isomorphism on $\lim^1$.
